title.zh: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
title.en: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company

current_state.zh: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi, its affiliates and two Susquehanna trading companies, alleging the platform has facilitated illegal event-contract betting for over 32,000 state residents since 2024 and asking a court to force the return of about $30–60 million in profits.
